metrics.description: Distributors flagged at risk (score < 30 with a bottom-15% sell-out trend, 3 weeks running).
metrics.label: At-risk distributors
metrics.name: at_risk_distributors

metrics.description: Trailing-30-day average daily secondary units, read on the last day of the period.
metrics.label: Avg daily sell-out (units, trailing 30d)
metrics.name: avg_daily_sellout_units

metrics.description: claims_per_1000_units restricted to base cracks, for a batch, plant, SKU, resin lot or manufacture period.
metrics.label: Base-crack claims per 1,000 units
metrics.name: base_crack_claims_per_1000_units

metrics.description: (cumulative primary shipped − cumulative secondary sold) ÷ trailing-30-day average daily secondary sales, in units, on the last day of the period.
metrics.label: Channel days of stock
metrics.name: channel_days_of_stock

metrics.description: Implied units held by distributors, read on the last day of the period.
metrics.label: Channel stock (units)
metrics.name: channel_stock_units

metrics.description: Warranty claims ÷ (serials shipped in the cohort ÷ 1000), for a batch, plant, SKU or manufacture period. To see the curve by age, group by months_since_ship and use cohort_cumulative_claims_per_1000 instead.
metrics.label: Claims per 1,000 units
metrics.name: claims_per_1000_units

metrics.description: Like cohort_cumulative_claims_per_1000, for base cracks only. Only meaningful grouped by months_since_ship.
metrics.label: Cumulative base-crack claims per 1,000 units (by age)
metrics.name: cohort_cumulative_base_crack_per_1000

metrics.description: Pooled cumulative claims per 1,000 shipped units at each months_since_ship. Only meaningful grouped by months_since_ship.
metrics.label: Cumulative claims per 1,000 units (by age)
metrics.name: cohort_cumulative_claims_per_1000

metrics.description: Serialised units shipped from the cohort's batches (counted once per batch).
metrics.label: Cohort units shipped
metrics.name: cohort_units_shipped

type_params.expr: case when months_since_ship = 0 then units_shipped else 0 end

metrics.description: Amount collected within payment terms ÷ amount invoiced, over invoices already due.
metrics.label: Collections efficiency
metrics.name: collections_efficiency

metrics.description: Weighted composite (0-100, higher = healthier) of region-peer percentiles: secondary-sales trend 35%, primary/secondary gap 20%, days-of-stock deviation 15%, DSO trend 20%, visit recency 10%.
metrics.label: Distributor health score
metrics.name: distributor_health_score

metrics.description: Amount-weighted average days from invoice to full payment. Invoices still open are aged to the as-of date.
metrics.label: DSO (days)
metrics.name: dso

metrics.description: Region-peer percentile of DSO ÷ own 52-week median, higher scores lower (weight 20%).
metrics.label: Health component: DSO trend (0-100)
metrics.name: health_dso_score

metrics.description: Region-peer percentile of trailing-12-week primary ÷ secondary units, higher gap scores lower (weight 20%).
metrics.label: Health component: sell-in vs sell-out (0-100)
metrics.name: health_gap_score

metrics.description: Region-peer percentile of trailing-8-week secondary units vs the same weeks a year earlier (weight 35%).
metrics.label: Health component: sell-out trend (0-100)
metrics.name: health_secondary_trend_score

metrics.description: Region-peer percentile of channel days of stock ÷ own 52-week median, higher scores lower (weight 15%).
metrics.label: Health component: days-of-stock deviation (0-100)
metrics.name: health_stock_score

metrics.description: Region-peer percentile of days since the last geofence-verified visit, longer scores lower (weight 10%).
metrics.label: Health component: visit recency (0-100)
metrics.name: health_visit_score

metrics.description: claims_per_1000_units grouped by installer instead of batch; compare an installer with its district.
metrics.label: Installer claim rate (per 1,000 units)
metrics.name: installer_claim_rate

type_params.expr: case when months_since_install = 0 then units_installed else 0 end
case when is_open and days_past_due > 0 then open_amount_inr else 0 end

metrics.description: Distributor × SKU × days with over 60 days of stock.
metrics.label: Overstock days
metrics.name: overstock_days

metrics.description: Share of distributor-SKU-days with channel days of stock above 60.
metrics.label: Overstock rate
metrics.name: overstock_rate

metrics.description: Σ primary_invoice_lines.qty × unit_price_inr, the company's sell-in to distributors, net of scheme discounts.
metrics.label: Primary sales value (₹)
metrics.name: primary_sales_value

metrics.description: Units invoiced to distributors (sell-in).
metrics.label: Primary units
metrics.name: primary_units

metrics.description: Share of a distributor's quarterly primary volume booked in the scheme window (last 15 days), divided by its own baseline share (median of its other quarters). 1.0 is normal; about 2 or more is quarter-end loading.
metrics.label: Scheme concentration ratio
metrics.name: scheme_concentration_ratio

metrics.description: Σ secondary_sales.qty × products.list_price_inr, sell-out valued at the current list price.
metrics.label: Secondary sales value (₹)
metrics.name: secondary_sales_value

metrics.description: Units sold by distributors to retailers (sell-out).
metrics.label: Secondary units
metrics.name: secondary_units

metrics.description: Distributor × SKU × days that have a days-of-stock value.
metrics.label: Distributor-SKU-days measured
metrics.name: stock_days_measured

metrics.description: Distributor × SKU × days with under 7 days of stock.
metrics.label: Stock-out days
metrics.name: stockout_days

metrics.description: Share of distributor-SKU-days with channel days of stock below 7.
metrics.label: Stock-out rate
metrics.name: stockout_rate

metrics.description: Distributor × window × category combinations ordering at ≥ 2× their trailing-90-day rate.
metrics.label: Stuffing flags
metrics.name: stuffing_flags

type_params.expr: case when is_stuffing_flag then 1 else 0 end

metrics.description: Window daily primary units ÷ the distributor's trailing-90-day daily average.
metrics.label: Scheme-window order rate ratio
metrics.name: stuffing_rate_ratio

metrics.label: Units registered within 90 days of shipment
metrics.name: units_registered_within_90d

type_params.expr: case when is_geofence_verified then 1 else 0 end

metrics.description: Share of shipped serials with an install date within 90 days of shipment (period = manufacture date).
metrics.label: Warranty registration rate
metrics.name: warranty_registration_rate

semantic_models.description: Nevada-chart cohorts: batch × months since shipment, with claims by failure mode and cumulative claims per 1,000 shipped units. The in-service clock starts at shipment. is_fully_observed means every unit has been out for the whole month.
semantic_models.name: batch_claim_cohorts

semantic_models.description: Production batch: plant, line, resin lot, and unit counts. Registration counts only use shipments at least 90 days old, so recent shipments don't drag the rate down.
semantic_models.name: batches

semantic_models.description: Channel stock per distributor × sku × ISO week: the snapshot on the week's last available day (the as-of date for the week in progress), plus counts of days measured, stock-out days (under 7 days of stock) and overstock days (over 60). Days with no sell-out in the trailing 30 days have no days of stock and count toward neither rate. RLS by region (via the distributor).
semantic_models.name: channel_inventory

semantic_models.description: distributor_health_score per distributor × completed ISO week: point-in-time, exactly as pre-registered in detectors/detectors.yaml. Five region-peer percentile components (0-100), a weighted score, and is_at_risk after 3 consecutive flag weeks. RLS by region.
semantic_models.name: distributor_health

semantic_models.description: Distributor master with region, rep, lifecycle and first/last invoice dates. RLS by region.
semantic_models.name: distributors

semantic_models.description: Sales-rep visits to distributors, with geofence verification. RLS by region.
semantic_models.name: field_visits

semantic_models.description: installer_claim_rate source: installer × district × install month × months since install, over installer-attributed registrations only.
semantic_models.name: installer_claim_cohorts

semantic_models.description: One row per primary invoice with payment status as of the as-of date. Open invoices age to the as-of date, so a distributor who stops paying is visible immediately instead of when late payments finally land. RLS by region.
semantic_models.name: invoice_collections

semantic_models.description: Company → distributor invoice lines (sell-in). RLS by region.
semantic_models.name: primary_sales

semantic_models.description: SKU catalogue. Tanks are serialised; sanitaryware is traded.
semantic_models.name: products

semantic_models.description: Quarter-end scheme participation per distributor × scheme window × category: the stuffing rate ratio, scheme_concentration_ratio, and the days-of-stock follow-through after quarter-end. RLS by region.
semantic_models.name: scheme_quarterly

semantic_models.description: Distributor → retailer sell-out as reported, with re-sent uploads removed. Sale dates within the reporting horizon are still filling in (is_settled = false). RLS by region.
semantic_models.name: secondary_sales

semantic_models.description: One row per warranty claim (all claims are on serialised tanks), with the unit's full lineage.
semantic_models.name: warranty_claims
